messages:
Sunita Shah: Morning team — Aperture Labs kickoff thread. Goal: align stakeholders, define success criteria, and lock the 30-day roadmap for go-live readiness. I'm scheduling a short sync Fri 10am PT. Can folks confirm availability and owners for SSO, data ingest, runtime tuning, and enablement artifacts?

Maria Lopez: Confirmed for Fri 10am. I'll drive enablement and client-facing training. Initial success criteria I propose: 1) sample dataset ingested into staging (>=1k rows), 2) SSO test users able to sign in to staging, 3) two enablement sessions recorded, 4) perf baseline <250ms p90 for common prompts.

Devin Park: I can own data ingest. Need sample CSV spec and S3 creds from Aperture. Note: they want incremental sync via SFTP — can we support that on staging?

Andrew Chen: I'll take runtime tuning and perf. Quick ask: what sequence lengths are we expecting for their top 10 prompts? If mostly short (<128) we can prioritize kernel selection for that distribution.

Sunita Shah: @Devin I'll DM the Aperture PM for SFTP creds and sample export. @Andrew expected sequences ~40-200, a handful up to 512 per their intake form.

Maria Lopez: High-level timeline (draft):
```
Week 0 (this week): discovery + SSO scope + sample data request
Week 1: staging deploy + ingest + basic smoke tests
Week 2: enablement sessions (internal + client) + perf tuning
Week 3: cutover prep + go/no-go + production rollout
```

Devin Park: Plan for data ingest: need SFTP endpoint + sample CSV (col headers + iso dates) + schema mapping doc. I'll run a dry-run ingest Tue and share logs.

Andrew Chen: For perf tuning I'll request a canary job on dedicated pool Wed. If we can get representative prompts, I'll run a 1k-request pass to produce p50/p90 numbers.

Sunita Shah: Risk note: Aperture mentioned SSO for their enterprise users is mandatory at go-live. If SSO is delayed beyond Week 1 we should flag renewal risk. Can we add a checklist item: SAML metadata + test IdP account?

Maria Lopez: Adding checklist item. Also request: two short enablement recordings (10–15m) covering admin setup and common troubleshooting — useful for renewal sentiment.

Devin Park: Quick snippet I'll use to test ingestion (example):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/customers/aperture/data \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@aperture_sample.csv" \
  -F "mapping=config.json"
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/ingest-service v2.3 -> Wed 03:00 UTC (maintenance window) :rocket:

Andrew Chen: If the deploy goes green, I'll queue the canary job for Wed 06:00 UTC and post results here.

Sunita Shah: Thanks all — owners: Devin (ingest), Andrew (perf), Maria (enablement). I'll create a shared checklist doc and add the Aperture PM. Please post blockers in this thread. If SSO looks risky after Tue discovery, we'll set a renewal-risk flag and escalate to AM. :warning:

Maria Lopez: Noted. I'll prep the enablement slides and invite client to two 30-min sessions next week.

Devin Park: I'll aim to post ingest dry-run logs by Tue EOD.

Andrew Chen: Will post perf numbers Wed morning.

Sunita Shah: Closing loop — Fri 10am PT sync still on. Agenda: confirm SSO scope, review ingest dry-run, review perf canary, enablement schedule, go/no-go criteria. Thanks :raised_hands:
